title: Sound envelope editor: waveform + draggable gain curve, trim, channels
description: Implement the Edit Envelope sound editor per docs/10-sound.md (Edit Envelope section). FIRST verify current SoundPanel/sound model state in packages/authoring-ui (SoundPanel) and packages/core sound/media model. Scope: (1) modal editor showing the audio waveform with a draggable gain envelope (handles add/move/remove) for left and right channels independently; (2) trim in/out point handles and a time-zoom control; (3) persist the envelope on the frame's sound instance model; (4) apply the envelope at publish in the SWF SoundInfo/DefineSound path in packages/swf. Primary files: packages/authoring-ui SoundPanel + new envelope editor component, packages/core sound model, packages/swf compiler media/sound-stream. DONE = author can shape a gain curve that persists and is encoded into SoundInfo envelope points (unit test on encode), typecheck + 3 unit suites green. Update docs/10 if detail changes.
